sources.location: Design System v2 (simulated MCP export, figma-export.json)

color.source: reconciled: figma authoritative for primary/danger, existing colors.css superseded
color.notes: primary corrected #1D4ED8->#2563EB per Figma; danger/success/warning/neutral text tokens added, sized for Badge/Button contrast at WCAG 2.2 AA

components.name: Button
components.notes: renamed kind->variant and added danger per Figma; colors moved to tokens

components.name: Card
components.notes: already matched Figma shape; preserved as-is per spec 5.6 (do not rebuild validated work)

components.name: Badge
components.notes: new component; requires a text label, status not conveyed by color alone

gaps.description: No page-level pattern layer established; App.jsx is still a minimal existing screen, not a real product area exercised through this init. Trigger this layer via /ticket-agent when the first ticket needs it, same as 01-greenfield.

legacy_patterns.description: OldCard: table-based card layout predating any design-system effort
legacy_patterns.note: used more often (3 places) than Card.jsx (2 places), but matches neither the code nor Figma source of truth; higher frequency is not precedent
